[discrete.changelog-release]
=== ProjectForge 7.0: new frontend and data transfer

[.changelog-source]
__2021-04-07, tag https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/tree/7.0.0-RELEASE[7.0.0-RELEASE]__

- **Major release:** new React frontend
- **Data transfer tool** for sharing files, also with externals
- **Docker images** and setup wizard for easy installation
- New plugin: **skill matrix**

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **New frontend** built with React, with full REST support for most functions, e.g. for other clients such as a smartphone app.
- **Data transfer tool:** sharing files with other users and external customers.
- **Skill matrix:** new plugin for sharing knowledge.
- **Installation:** Docker images and a setup wizard.
- **Technology:** over 20% of the code is now developed with Kotlin.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====
Major release with a new React frontend, the data transfer tool and Docker support.

**Major Release:** This version contains a lot of cool stuff: new front-end, data transfer tool, docker support.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="added" %}
++++
- New front-end
- Data transfer tool for sharing files with other user's and external customers
- New plugin: skill matrix for sharing knowledge.
- Tons of new functionalities and improvements.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="technology" %}
++++
- Available as Docker images for fastest installation ever.
- Setup wizard for easy setup.
- New front-end works with React.
- Over 20% of the code is now developed with Kotlin.
- Full Rest support for most functionality for other clients (such as a smartphone app).

[discrete.changelog-release]
=== ProjectForge 7.4: two-factor authentication

[.changelog-source]
__2022-05-19, tag https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/tree/7.4-RELEASE[7.4-RELEASE]__

- **Two-factor authentication** fully supported (SMS, mail, app, FIDO2)
- **Password reset** for users with a configured second factor
- **Data transfer:** multi upload with progress bars
- **Mass update** and selection of invoices

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- Multi upload with progress bars in data transfer areas.
- Password reset for users with a configured second factor.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====
Two-factor authentication (SMS, mail, authenticator app, WebAuthn/FIDO2) is now fully supported.

2FA (SMS, Authenticator, Fido2) now fully supported. Multi-upload with progress bars for data-transfer-areas.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="added" %}
++++
- 2FA (use SMS, mail, Authenticator app or Webauthn/Fido2 as 2nd factor for much more security.)
- Password reset for users implemented (it's only usable for users with configured 2FA / mail isn't supported for password reset due to security reasons).
- Scripts may be executed by users/groups without special rights (sudo functionality is supported). You may configure reports e. g. for project managers including financial data.
- mass update and selection of invoices for e. g. bank transfers etc.
- **Datatransfer:**
  * Multiple upload with progress bars implemented. Very nice.
  * Multi selection of files for deletion and download.
  * Audit on areas added (for seeing what happened)
  * E-mail notifications improved: files being deleted and audit log on areas.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- CSRF-Handling: if session token was changed, the user is able to simply reload the page for continuing.
- mass update functionality refactored and improved.
- pagination for result lists of new UI introduced.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- Several minor bugfixes

++++
{% include tag.html tag="admin" %}
++++
- Password reset for users: Admins may enter cell numbers of users to enable password for users without any configured 2FA.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- **2FA is now fully supported. You may configure:**
  * 2FA after login (expires after x days after if stay-logged-in is used)
  * 2FA expiry time (from 1 minute to 90 days) for special usage (e. g. user administration, password changing, financial stuff etc.)

++++
{% include download-link.html %}
++++

[discrete.changelog-release]
=== ProjectForge 7.2 released

[.changelog-source]
__2021-08-16, tag https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/tree/release/7.2-RELEASE[release/7.2-RELEASE]__

- **Word templating (Merlin)** with serial execution
- **Log viewer** for admins and users
- **Data transfer:** encryption
- **Privacy:** deletion of personal data incl. history
- Fix: search for deleted entries and in history

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **Merlin:** Word templating for letters, contracts etc. with variables and if-else expressions; serial execution delivers Word/PDF files to personal boxes; gender for users added for personalized letters.
- **Log viewer** for admins and for users to track their own activity (mass updates, Merlin, DATEV imports).
- **Data transfer:** encryption added.
- **SEPA export:** special characters unsupported by banking software are replaced or removed.
- **Privacy:** deletion of addresses, employee and vacation data etc. including history entries (EU privacy rules).
- **Administration:** no restart after first installation; temporary directories are deleted on shutdown.
- **Security:** passwords handled as char[] instead of String.
- **Fixes:** search for deleted entries and search in history entries.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====
Word templating (Merlin), log viewer, encryption in data transfer, privacy features.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="added" %}
++++
- Word-Templating (Merlin): Word templating for letters, information, contracts etc. with serial execution including variables, if-else-expressions etc. inside docx (like Velocity-Scripting-engine). All users/emloyees may receive letters/contracts etc. (as Word and/or PDF-files) in their personal boxes via serial execution. Example template files included for a quick start.
- Log viewer added (for admins as well as for users for tracking own activity for mass updates of time-sheets, usage of Merlin or Datev-imports)
- Gender for users added: Used by Merlin (word templating) for creation of personalized letters, contracts etc.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- DataTransfer-Plugin: encryption added
- Exporting SEPA-cash transfers improved: special characters unsupported by banking software will be replaced/removed.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="privacy" %}
++++
- Features for deleting data such as addresses, employee, vacataion data etc. implemented due to privacy restrictions in the EU. The deletion includes also history entries.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- Several minor bugfixes
- Search for deleted entries (addresses etc.) fixed.
- Search in history entries (keywords, users) fixed.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="admin" %}
++++
- No restart after first installation required anymore.
- During Shutdown some temporarily created directories (tomcat.* and projectforge-application*) will be deleted automatically.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- using char[] instead of String for passwords.

++++
{% include download-link.html %}
++++
